toml:
# Relative navigation of a three-craft formation in the booklet's highly elliptical orbit.
#
# A chief and two deputies (offset in true anomaly at perigee by 0.02 and 0.05 degrees, a few kilometres apart) each run
# the onboard filter on their own pseudoranges. The deputies' positions relative to the chief are estimated two ways: by
# subtracting the independent absolute estimates, and by a relative filter on single-differenced pseudoranges of the signals
# both craft track. Differencing removes what the two links share; the relative dynamics are the difference of two nonlinear
# trajectories, so the relative filter keeps its accuracy through stretches with too few signals. The limb medium is on, and
# its excess delay (which the filters do not model) is largely common to the two links and so cancels in the differences.
#
# MODELLED: simulated truth, forces and noise; no flight formation data.

kind = "gnss-ssv"
name = "HEO formation relative navigation (reduced length)"

[constellations]
include = ["gps", "glonass", "galileo", "bds"]
bands = ["l1", "l5"]

[receiver]
cn0_min_dbhz = 20.0

[atmosphere]

[navigation]
preset = "heo"
duration_min = 400.0
step_s = 60.0
antennas = ["booklet-high-gain-nadir", "booklet-patch-zenith"]
series_every_min = 40.0

[formation]
offsets_deg = [0.02, 0.05]
